reason: Linux drm_gem_mmap() rejects non-zero-offset mmap(map.offset + page_size) with EINVAL via exact vma_node offset lookup, and TEST_RES returns MAP_FAILED which the test dereferences, causing SIGSEGV.
restore_when: Guard MAP_FAILED in gem_create_dumb_buffer.c, align sub-range dumb-buffer mmap expectations with Linux drm_gem_mmap(), and verify the checks after the crash point.

reason: test_hwrng_nonblock_succeeds_after_cache_prime expects a 64-byte O_NONBLOCK read after reading 1 byte, which returns 63 cached bytes on Linux hw_random.
restore_when: Fix hwrng.c to allow the remaining cached byte count or prime without draining the 64-byte buffer.

reason: test_vt_openqry_reflects_opened_vt calls VT_OPENQRY immediately after close(next_vt_fd) and intermittently observes a different VT under SMP KVM on Linux 6.16.
restore_when: Poll VT_OPENQRY briefly after close(next_vt_fd) or synchronize VT release in vt_ioctl.c on Linux.

reason: Linux ext2 does not implement fallocate(2) and returns EOPNOTSUPP.
restore_when: Re-enable only if the reference kernel gains ext2 fallocate support or the test guards Linux ext2 expectations.

reason: test_direct_preadv_fills_iovecs_in_order mixes buffered pwrite/ftruncate on fd with concurrent O_DIRECT preadv on direct_fd on Linux 6.16 ext2.
restore_when: Separate buffered and O_DIRECT coherence assumptions in preadv_short_read.c on Linux.

reason: Linux ext2 buffered write across an unmapped tail writes the valid first byte instead of failing the whole write with EFAULT.
restore_when: Align ext2 short-write expectations or guard the Asterinas-specific assertion behind __asterinas__.

reason: test_listmount_rejects_unmounted_parent calls umount while cwd is inside the child mount (EBUSY), and MNT_ID_REQ_SIZE_VER0 + 8 equals valid VER1 size on Linux 6.16.
restore_when: Leave LM_CHILD before calling umount and use a request size larger than MNT_ID_REQ_SIZE_VER1.

reason: test_dino_matches_stat_and_is_stable fails on first_pass.parent == st_root.st_ino because it compares the merged mount root's .. d_ino against stat(MERGED_DIR).
restore_when: Verify Linux overlayfs mount-root .. d_ino behavior or test .. on a subdirectory inside the overlay in xino_dino_identity.c.

reason: access_from_sibling() in pid_mem.c forks accessor without waiting for target to finish drop_capability(CAP_SYS_PTRACE), creating a Linux commoncap ptrace race under SMP KVM.
restore_when: Add a readiness pipe in access_from_sibling() so parent waits for target to drop CAP_SYS_PTRACE before forking accessor.

reason: test_proc_sys_kernel_overflow_ids_require_cap_sys_admin drops CAP_SYS_ADMIN with euid 0, whereas Linux allows DAC root writes to /proc/sys/kernel/overflowuid and overflowgid.
restore_when: Drop euid/uid or guard the Asterinas capability check when running on Linux.

reason: test_special_fds expects ENODEV for fallocate on pidfd, whereas Linux 6.16 pidfs returns EOPNOTSUPP.
restore_when: Accept EOPNOTSUPP on Linux or fix Asterinas/test alignment.

reason: Linux 6.16 returns EPERM when chmod targets the shared anonymous inode, whereas the test expects EOPNOTSUPP.
restore_when: Accept EPERM on Linux or align Asterinas/test expectations for anonymous inode chmod.

reason: Linux binds bochs-drm to QEMU's VGA PCI device (0000:00:01.0) when CONFIG_DRM_BOCHS=y, whereas pci.c requires /sys/devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:01.0/driver to be absent.
restore_when: Check the exact /sys/bus/pci/drivers/bochs-drm binding and reverse link on Linux in fs/sysfs/device/pci.c while keeping the unbound-driver assertion on Asterinas.

reason: test_preadv2_pwritev2_invalid_flags passes 0xf0 expecting EOPNOTSUPP, but all four bits are valid Linux 6.16 RWF_* flags (RWF_APPEND | RWF_NOAPPEND | RWF_ATOMIC | RWF_DONTCACHE) whose invalid combination returns EINVAL.
restore_when: Pass an unassigned flag bit outside RWF_SUPPORTED in iovec_err.c to test EOPNOTSUPP.

reason: test_mremap_may_fail_after_unmap and test_mremap_dontunmap fail VMA hole and unaligned-length checks on Linux 6.16.
restore_when: Reconcile mremap VMA-gap and MREMAP_DONTUNMAP semantics and update the test expectations.

reason: test_underflow_addr expects EPERM for MAP_FIXED below mmap_min_addr while running as root, whereas Linux cap_mmap_addr() exempts CAP_SYS_RAWIO.
restore_when: Drop CAP_SYS_RAWIO before testing mmap_min_addr enforcement on Linux.

reason: test_rss_file maps a file on rootfs/ramfs and expects RssFile to increase, whereas Linux 6.16 does not account ramfs mappings in RssFile.
restore_when: Run the file-backed RSS subtest on ext2 or adjust ramfs RSS expectations on Linux.

reason: test_socket_timeout updates SO_RCVTIMEO/SO_SNDTIMEO on sk_listen after connect() and expects sk_accepted to inherit the updated values, whereas Linux clones timeouts during connection establishment rather than at accept().
restore_when: Clone listener timeouts at connection establishment in Asterinas or guard the accept()-time expectation in sockoption.c.

reason: test_pass_cred and test_peer_groups expect AF_INET SO_PASSCRED support and listening/accepted SO_PEERGROUPS error semantics that differ on Linux 6.16.
restore_when: Align AF_UNIX/AF_INET socket-option tests with Linux behavior or gate Asterinas-specific checks.

reason: test_disable_reuse_after_bound assumes disabling SO_REUSEADDR after bind() still permits port reuse on Linux, whereas Linux 6.16 returns EADDRINUSE.
restore_when: Update the #ifndef __asterinas__ branch in tcp_reuseaddr.c for modern Linux bind conflict checks.

reason: Tests Asterinas's internal ring-buffered TCP socket behavior.
restore_when: Keep Asterinas-only.

reason: test_listen expects listen(sk_accepted, 10) on an AF_UNIX SEQPACKET socket to return EINVAL, whereas Linux 6.16 succeeds.
restore_when: Reconcile accepted AF_UNIX listen() semantics or update unix_streamlike_prologue.h.

reason: test_listen expects listen(sk_accepted, 10) on an AF_UNIX STREAM socket to return EINVAL, whereas Linux 6.16 succeeds.
restore_when: Reconcile accepted AF_UNIX listen() semantics or update unix_streamlike_prologue.h.

reason: cgroup.sh hardcodes 3 lines in inactive child cpu.stat, whereas Linux 6.16 emits 5 lines.
restore_when: Update cgroup.sh to check the required usage fields rather than total line count.

reason: test_clone_normalizes_invalid_exit_signal clones with exit signal 255 and waits without __WALL, failing ECHILD after Linux normalizes exit signal 255 to 0.
restore_when: Pass __WALL to waitpid or adjust the Linux expectation in clone_invalid_exit_signal.c.

reason: test_execveat_empty_path expects the legacy Linux fd number in /proc/self/comm under #ifndef __asterinas__, whereas Linux 6.16 sets comm to the executable basename.
restore_when: Update execve_comm.c so Linux >= 6.14/6.16 expects the executable basename.

reason: do_execve_fatal expects malformed ELF loading past point of no return to terminate the child with SIGSEGV, which does not match Linux 6.16.
restore_when: Update execve_err.c failure assertions for Linux 6.16 or fix Asterinas parity.

reason: test_setpgid_invalid expects setpgid(-1, current) to fail with EINVAL, whereas Linux 6.16 returns ESRCH.
restore_when: Reconcile setpgid(-1, ...) errno ordering between Asterinas and Linux.

reason: Linux 6.16 returns EBADF for PIDFD_SELF_THREAD_GROUP with PIDFD_SIGNAL_PROCESS_GROUP in a nonleader child, whereas the test expects ESRCH.
restore_when: Update pidfd_send_signal.c expectations or wait for upstream self-pidfd alignment.

reason: Recursive SIGUSR1 delivery fails on_sig_stack uc_stack assertions on Linux 6.16.
restore_when: Investigate Linux 6.16 ucontext uc_stack semantics and align test or kernel behavior.

reason: Shebang multi-argument invocation violates execve_child's NUL-delimited /proc/self/cmdline parser, and zero-length security.capability setxattr succeeds on Linux 6.16.
restore_when: Adjust execve.c shebang and zero-length capability xattr expectations on Linux.
